driver: STM32N6 true random number generator (RNG) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 47 (RNG) + memory map p.177
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.47 RNG register interface + memory map p.177 (RNG secure base 0x54020000)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the RNG campaign work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure RNG (stm32n6xx.h)

Enable, disable and query the generator (RNG_CR.RNGEN); enable, disable and query the clock error detection (RNG_CR.CED, written together with RNG_CR.CONDRST); enable, disable and query the interrupt (RNG_CR.IE)

Query the data ready, clock error and seed error status flags (RNG_SR.DRDY, CECS, SECS, CEIS, SEIS) and clear the clock and seed error interrupt status (RNG_SR.CEIS, RNG_SR.SEIS); read the 32-bit random data (RNG_DR)

Out of scope: HAL API, the conditioning soft reset as a function of its own, the configuration lock, the NIST/RNG_CONFIG1-3/clock divider/auto-reset configuration, the noise source (RNG_NSCR) and health test (RNG_HTCR) registers, the seed error recovery sequence, the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_rng.c, the RNG kernel clock enable (RCC)

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25) and the feature 014 operation-24 campaign (2026-10-27)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 014 operation-24 campaign (owner 2026-10-27: new ST LL drivers RNG, LPTIM, WWDG): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 RNG LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects RNG_S at 0x54020000).

scope.note: generator enable, clock error detection, interrupt enable, status flags and their clears, random data read
